name: Brali Gold 20 candidate set
selection_note: Observed user demand is not collected yet. This first candidate set is an editorial product hypothesis based on recurring practical problem clusters, current trusted status, existing retrieval/evaluation coverage, actionability, safety boundaries and whether an outcome can be observed. Candidate selection is not Gold approval.

first_batch_exclusions.reason: The source-bounded review in #93 did not make this protocol eligible for the current trusted Protocol Feed. Gold selection follows the trust gate rather than review-batch membership.

candidates.problem: Our group needs independent ideas before discussion converges on the first suggestion.
I have a goal but keep failing to turn it into a workable next action.
My workday is overloaded and I need a smaller visible plan.
I am stuck polishing or delaying and need a bounded first pass.
I need a clear focus boundary without pretending one timer length is optimal.
Long work periods are becoming unproductive and I need deliberate work/rest boundaries.
My immediate workspace is creating friction and I want a tiny reset before work.
I need to remember material rather than only reread it.
I want a low-interference period after learning before adding more material.
My learning is scattered and I need one narrow weekly practice target.
I want a small repeatable language-practice container without an invented retention promise.
I may be misunderstanding someone and need a correction-friendly listening loop.
A handoff or request is unclear and I need to make missing context explicit.
I am investigating a problem without a testable explanation or next check.
I need to examine why a goal or problem matters without pretending one root cause is proven.
I want to compare two low-risk options and learn from the result without overstating an informal test.
I am spending effort on factors I cannot control and need to separate action from acceptance.
My schedule leaves too little sleep opportunity and I need a conservative way to review the pattern.
I need a small everyday movement option without treating it as a therapeutic dose.
Long screen sessions are uncomfortable and I need a simple distance-looking break cue.
